other_conditions: Applicant must be a registered livestock owner or breeder.
Animal death must be due to natural disasters (floods, droughts, earthquakes, cyclones), diseases (anthrax, bird flu), or poisoning (food poisoning, snake bites, chemical poisoning).
benefits_summary: Provides direct cash compensation via DBT up to ₹37,500 per large dairy animal (maximum 3), ₹4,000 per small dairy animal (maximum 30), ₹32,000 per large non‑milch animal (maximum 3), ₹20,000 per small non‑milch animal (maximum 3), and ₹100 per adult duck/poultry (maximum 100, up to ₹10,000).
